notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Previously it was not possible to manipulate some of the special video adjustments like Zoom, Scale and Tilt using the Vive Controllers.
This has now been fixed and the controls behave just the same as when manipulated with the mouse.

Some minor performance issues has been addressed.

- Happy watching :-)

notes.title: New features and Bug fixes
notes.content:
You are now able to swap "left and right eye". This is useful for videos recorded with cameras inverted so to speak.

We have fixed the video and sound de-synching by lowering the default resolution. We believe the issue stems from us rendering the screen at a too high resolution causing the GPU to lack behind the audio thus causing it to de-sync.

We have also added a button where you can toggle the resolution between Low, Medium and High in order to accommodate all levels of GPUs.

Thank you,
The NexVR team
